retention_rule: One decision per exact SHA-256; acquisition events remain distinct. Prior batch decisions and bindings remain unchanged. All raw catalogue/journal/blocked responses stay restricted except the licensed CRAI reproduction-service HTML; selected facts are project-created metadata. Retention is not original-book acquisition or text coverage.
limitations: No exact Rome 1634 original title, colophon, liturgical body or full facsimile acquired. The original-source gap remains open.
CCPB and CSUC are not evidence of a second complete, independently dated physical copy. CCPB corroborates the same UB holding and identifies its shelfmark field.
The Urban VIII approval act dated 2 September 1634 remains separate from any questioned historical printing date.
Rome 1635 edition statements/settings and Antwerp 1634 copies remain distinct; none substitutes for Rome 1634.

The FIDES Venetian comparison remains a catalogue lead only. Mixed k./s. extent and signature notation are preserved, with no claim of UB equivalence, redating, identical plate reuse or textual ancestry.
Successful indexed searches have declared result bounds; 403/429/challenge/timeouts are access failures. Neither proves global or historical absence.
No external request, order, email, publication, canonical installation, index update, commit or push was made by this lane.
